entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.0.1
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could reload the preset and undo your DRIVE / TONE / MIX tweaks. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was PRESET. That first slot now does nothing; PRESET is a new parameter at the end (same menu, same Q-Link). Saved projects open with their preset and settings as before.

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.0.0**, the first release. A soft clipper and bus saturator for your MPC: warmth, glue and loudness without clipping. Three characters (soft, tape, hard), tone, ceiling, level match and 12 one-tap presets. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat#readme) for everything it does and its limitations. **Download** `PotentialHeat-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below.
